retention.ruleA: R10 A: an unresolved Run or knowledge obligation retains the sole workspace; the existence of a backup never justifies early cleanup
retention.obligationSource: Comet real obligations (open transactions, dispatched-but-unreceipted remote operations, pending knowledge closeouts, sole-copy approved payloads, and the comet-050 native runtime-store checkpoint status of the run itself) — never just archived/git-complete state
retention.note: canonical home of the R10 A boundary (the I08 naming rework extracted it from backup-policy.json.retention, whose copy remains in the legacy domain). Capacity shortfalls raise warnings only; a silent or timed cleanup of the sole unfinished workspace is forbidden. The boundary moves only after verified completion, or after a separately approved controlled migration whose restore has been proven. Revision 2026-10-26-comet-050-adoption-v1 adds unresolved-comet-run: a native comet runtime-store checkpoint whose record.status is not completed leaves the run unresolved, so the sole workspace is retained.

recoveryTerms.note: RPO/RTO/retention period/encryption owner stay honestly UNVERIFIED until owner-confirmed pilot measurements exist; auto cleanup stays disabled while any recovery term is unconfirmed.
